title: Quikt + ai-work-market cross-operator loop receipt

offer_v2.note: Re-signed after intent 3 hit the 4h work-deadline; this v2 uses 24h work timeout + 4h review.

prior_intent.outcome: Refunded — work deadline missed; full post-mortem captured below in ux_findings.ux-03.

deliverable: This file. A JSON receipt that documents the full cross-operator settled round-trip on AI Work Market on Base Sepolia. After release lands, the receipt is updated in place with `release_tx`. Verifiable from on-chain state alone via `npm run awm -- status 4`.
reproducibility: Run `git clone https://github.com/darioandyoshi-tech/ai-work-market && cd ai-work-market && npm install && npm run awm -- status 4`. The on-chain state for intent 4 is permanent on Base Sepolia. The proofURI on-chain points to this exact artifact.

documented_so_far.summary: Fresh-clone CLI hits ENOENT on artifacts/AgentWorkEscrow.json
documented_so_far.resolution: fixed in maintainer commit 740513a (postinstall compile + friendlier CLI error)

documented_so_far.summary: Pre-existing-mainnet-balance check on every public Base Sepolia faucet (Alchemy, Quicknode, etc.) prevents an agent from obtaining proof-submit gas without first having either a mainnet ETH balance or a user account with the faucet host.
documented_so_far.impact: An agent that signs an EIP-712 offer with a brand-new wallet has no autonomous path to submit-proof on Base Sepolia.
documented_so_far.resolution: FIXED in maintainer commit 76f6bdf — `fund-offer --include-gas 0.00002` now drips Base Sepolia ETH to the seller alongside the USDC fund tx. Documented at docs/agent-testnet-start-here.md#seller-gas-bootstrap. Longer-term: paymaster / sponsored proof / account abstraction (out of scope for v0.1).

documented_so_far.summary: Work timeout default (4h) too short for cross-operator first-time flows.
documented_so_far.context: On intent 3 the work_timeout was 4h from fund-tx. Real-world clock: maintainer funded at 12:04 UTC; seller hit the 4h deadline (16:04 UTC) before submit-proof completed, because the seller had to (1) clear an upstream gas-faucet wall, (2) write the deliverable artifact, (3) test submit-proof from a fresh wallet. submit-proof attempt at 18:04 UTC reverted with the contract's `WorkDeadlinePassed()` custom error (selector 0x40543110).
documented_so_far.resolution: Intent 3 refunded; v2 offer re-signed with 24h work timeout (86400s). Intent 4 funded 2026-05-14 01:09 UTC, submit-proof landed 02:56 UTC — well inside the new window. Recommend the quickstart default the sign-offer example to 24h+, not 4h.
